title: Temple of Aeryn
description:
• Explore a vast world, uncover its mysteries and meet its inhabitants.

• Cast mighty spells to defeat your enemies in a unique turn-based combat system.

• Summon many different creatures to fight by your side.

• Focus your spirit to learn new spells and evolve your Spellbook.

Progress is made solely trough spells which change combat dynamics and are cruicial in order to advance.

Note this game is a Card Battler with a Adventure part. 
It's not a conventional RPG.
description_short: A fantasy adventure game inspired by C64 classics. Discover your destiny as a powerful sorcerer, summon mighty creatures, and unravel ancient mysteries as you explore the curious and deadly world of Temple of Aeryn.
